cards.name: SOLA Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers explore the forest, study pond wildlife, hear stories and make nature-based crafts. Weekly themes include midsummer traditions, fairies and frogs, and equine-inspired activities, with equine activities limited to students over 10.
cards.review_notes: The camp page gives dates under its Summer Camp 2026 heading. Confirm the campus drop-off address and registration destination. Mid Summer Night Camp culminates in a family camping trip at the Forest Cathedral; its overnight timing and logistics are not stated, so it remains a row of the day camp rather than a separate youth overnight program.

cards.name: Teen Waterfall Backpacking Trip
cards.description: Teens participate in a guided backpacking journey with hiking, swimming near waterfalls and campfire reflection. Activities focus on teamwork and outdoor skills.
cards.review_notes: Overnight format is inferred from the three-day guided backpacking journey and campfire activities; the page does not explicitly state overnight accommodation. Confirm format, departure and pickup location, trip hours and registration destination.
